reels.title: M36 METBEX
reels.caption:
Every chef burned dinner once. 🍳

Same kitchen, two plans. One cooks one meal a day. One orders delivery. Day 30, burnt dinner. Next day, he cooks again. A year later: 365 meals cooked vs $4,380 on delivery.

Bad days are part of learning. Keep cooking.

Send this to someone who orders every night.

#cooking #lifeskills #habits #money #selfimprovement

reels.title: M37 BASKETBOL
reels.yt_title: Every swish started as a miss #Shorts
reels.caption:
Every swish started as a miss. 🏀

Same ball, two plans. One shoots 100 shots a day. One watches highlights. Day 30: 0 for 10. Next day, he shoots again. A year later: 90% accuracy vs 912 clips watched.

Listen to the sound change. Clank… clank… swish.

Send this to someone who only watches.

#basketball #practice #discipline #habits #motivation
